name: cl_Au20
title: Au20 cluster
description: Gas-phase Au20. DFT and photoelectron spectroscopy give a tetrahedral (Td) pyramid, a 20-atom fcc fragment (Li, Li, Zhai & Wang, Science 299, 864 (2003)). NEP89 instead prefers a low-symmetry structure with one interior atom; the relaxed Td pyramid is 0.11 eV higher.
